fields.description: Terra Gardens is an Emaar residential collection in Expo Living, beside Expo City in Dubai South. Two apartment buildings and a townhouse collection sit around shared outdoor spaces. One to three bedroom apartments and three bedroom townhouses give the development a mix of compact homes and larger family layouts.

overview: The buildings use large areas of glazing and balconies around landscaped courtyards. The brochure places particular emphasis on daily outdoor use: a jogging route, garden spaces and a pavilion complement the swimming pools. Its environmental proposals include shaded balconies, insulated walls, efficient building systems, recycled irrigation water and separated waste collection. These are published design intentions, not independently measured energy savings or a certification claim. The Expo City cultural and exhibition facilities provide the broader setting, while future expansion and retail proposals should be considered separately from what is already operating.
research.locationNote: Emaar places Expo Living beside Expo City in Dubai South. The project map identifies Expo Road, Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road and the Expo City Metro connection. Airport and exhibition-centre expansion form part of the wider development story; confirm current walking access, local facilities and transport routes before choosing a home.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s current selection starts at AED 1,642,888, above the retained AED 1.55m headline. The reviewed launch sheet lists one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments from AED 1.55m, AED 2.27m and AED 3.43m, with townhouses from AED 4.88m. These are historical type prices, not confirmed current offers.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule shows 10% booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at completion. February and July 2028 are tied to 60% and 80% construction respectively. Earlier dates have passed, so request a current unit-specific statement of amounts due.
research.handoverNote: October 2029 is the estimated completion month in the payment document, also reported by Property Finder. It is not a guarantee of possession on a particular day.

facts.label: Original home mix
facts.value: 560 homes: 323 one-bedroom, 209 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom apartments, plus eight townhouses. Launch counts do not represent available stock.

facts.label: Townhouse living
facts.value: Both townhouse plans have two levels, a ground-floor bedroom, maid’s room, laundry and store. Type 1 includes 507.41 sq ft of balcony/terrace; Type 1.1 provides 626.89 sq ft.

facts.label: Interior direction
facts.value: The fact sheet describes wood-veneer joinery, engineered stone and tinted glass with a soft beige palette. Confirm the final unit specification and finishes schedule.

facts.label: Apartment plan coverage
facts.value: Building 1’s pack contains one- and two-bedroom layouts. Building 2 also contains the three-bedroom homes; those drawings include laundry and a separate store. The official download labelled floor plans contains only townhouses, so both apartment packs are linked separately in the source list.
